title: Asymmetric Perturbation Bounds with Profile 2 Seed
scientific_hypothesis: Constraining boundary layer perturbations (indices 0-2 and 15-17) to ±15 nm while allowing core layers (indices 3-14) ±30 nm will reduce thickness excursions that destabilize spectral edges while maintaining optimization freedom in the stack interior where field intensity is lower.
design_principle: Boundary layers experience higher field intensity and are more sensitive to thickness errors; core layers tolerate larger variations. This asymmetric bound strategy balances robustness with optimization freedom.
proposed_topology: 18-layer alternating TiO2/SiO2 stack on fused silica substrate, starting with TiO2 (high index) at air interface, ending with SiO2 (low index) at substrate interface
design_variables: layer thicknesses with asymmetric perturbation bounds: layers 0-2 and 15-17 bounded to ±15 nm from seed, layers 3-14 bounded to ±30 nm from seed
manufacturing_considerations: thickness tolerance sensitivity analysis recommended post-optimization
theory_basis: Transfer matrix method for multilayer interference
Field intensity distribution in dielectric stacks peaks at boundaries
expected_advantages: Reduced boundary layer thickness variance improves spectral edge stability
Core layer freedom maintains optimization capacity for band shaping
Profile 2 seed provides proven starting point from prior iteration
known_risks: Asymmetric bounds may trap optimizer in local minimum if seed is suboptimal
18-layer count may be insufficient to close 0.1043 headroom gap
execution_request_english: Optimize an 18-layer TiO2/SiO2 dielectric stack on fused silica substrate at 45 degree incidence for unpolarized light. Layer sequence: TiO2, SiO2, TiO2, SiO2, TiO2, SiO2, TiO2, SiO2, TiO2, SiO2, TiO2, SiO2, TiO2, SiO2, TiO2, SiO2, TiO2, SiO2 (18 layers total, starting with TiO2 at air interface). Initialize thicknesses to [174.47, 201.69, 182.61, 99.19, 166.54, 299.73, 55.42, 91.41, 211.51, 103.06, 173.72, 227.47, 172.37, 74.51, 222.81, 77.31, 205.14, 262.69] nm. Apply asymmetric perturbation bounds during optimization: layers 0, 1, 2, 15, 16, 17 constrained to seed value ±15 nm; layers 3 through 14 constrained to seed value ±30 nm. Optimize for maximum reflectance in 450-650 nm band and maximum transmittance in 700-1000 nm band. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 450-650 nm, 700-1000 nm. soft objectives: high reflectance in 450-650 nm; high transmittance in 700-1000 nm; minimized crosstalk between bands. behaviors to suppress or avoid: transmittance in 450-650 nm; reflectance in 700-1000 nm. manufacturing constraints: maximum 24 layers.
revision_reason: Implements feedback directive for asymmetric perturbation bounds to prevent boundary layer thickness excursions while maintaining core optimization freedom. Uses Profile 2 seed from iteration 06 which achieved highest score (0.8957) with superior boundary stability.
